projects.name: OpenPurpose
projects.tagline: Correct your agent once. Every agent remembers.
projects.description: Shared, scoped rules for coding agents over MCP. Corrections become learnings you review like a pull request.

projects.name: OpenAnnounce
projects.tagline: One place for every message your systems show.
projects.description: News, banners and maintenance notices written once, shown in every web app to the right user groups.

projects.name: OpenRelay
projects.tagline: Parcels to a pick-up point near your customers.
projects.description: A delivery network of shops, couriers and pick-up points. One QR code per parcel, one scan per hand-off.

projects.name: OpenVersion
projects.tagline: Tell open tabs a new version is live.
projects.description: CI publishes each release, and every open tab offers a reload, or reloads at a safe moment for a hard release. Roll back or force a refresh from the dashboard.

projects.name: OpenUsecase
projects.tagline: Use cases agents propose, people approve and tests prove.
projects.description: Before it builds, a coding agent writes down the behaviour. You approve it in an inbox, tests carry its ID, and each use case shows whether they pass.

projects.name: OpenStuff Design
projects.tagline: The toolkit under all of it.
projects.description: Tokens, CSS and Angular components, themed from one colour. It’s why the other sites feel like family.
